items.label: Sectional Patio Furniture
items.value: This patio furniture set is adaptable and movable. There are at least 4 different combinations to meet your different needs and space

items.label: Handwork PE Rattan
items.value: The rattan of this outdoor furniture is handwoven, which provides some coolness in summer. Stable and durable, suitable for your backyard, poolside and porch

items.label: Sturdy and Durable Frame
items.value: This patio furniture is constructed from the strong powder-coated durable steel frame. Seating clips prevent seats from moving if you need them to be together

items.label: Perfect for Leisure Time
items.value: This outdoor conversation set provide you a perfect seat to enjoy leisure time with your family and friends or entertaining your neighbors

items.label: Modern and Comfortable
items.value: The patio furniture with cushions and pillows provide much comfort when sitting. The covers of the cushions and pillows are movable and washable

items.label: Warn tips
items.value: This sectional outdoor furniture includes 2 corner chairs, 1 armless chair, 1 ottoman chair, 1 glass coffee table

items.label: Included Components
items.value: Chairs x 4, Coffee Table x 1, Cushions x 4, Pillows x 2

items.label: Assembly Instructions Description
items.value: Assembly is required and instructions are provided.

items.label: Product Care Instructions
items.value: Wimple with Damp Cloth, Wipe with Dry
